evidence: Sound token-accounting mechanism, self-consistent with twopool limitations (sec sim-limitations). The simulation sets the language pool's prefill length to the trace's ContextTokens verbatim, which embeds the traced model's ~66-tokens-per-image vision tokenization -- roughly 3x below a Qwen3-VL-consistent 196-per-image prefill. This undercounts frames-class language work, so the TP2 burst-window PASS (margin) is convention-dependent: under the heavier (correct) convention the thin TP2 margin could flip. By contrast the TP1 prefill floor is robust because it 'worsens at 3x the tokens' -- more prefill only makes the floor fail harder, so the verdict (fails at TP1) is convention-invariant. The vision verdict is independent because encoder cost is counted separately as a full 448^2 forward per image, not via ContextTokens. The differential dependence (which verdicts move under the convention, which do not) is derived from the accounting mechanism, not asserted.
